_comment: Known upstream module findings, so they do not hide new ones (I-117). Each entry matches the text of a module error from get-module-errors by substring; module '*' matches any. max caps how many findings the entry may absorb. The first rehearsal run tunes the match strings against real text; an entry the run did not see is listed as unseen, and is removed when the module's release fixes it.

expected.why: Automated Conditions 5e logs notices through the error log: LOADED, 'No targets selected' (the kit casts and rolls without targets) and 'Multiple damage types' (2026-10-27, 14.606.4.5). Informational.
The load-time hook count of Automated Conditions 5e.

Automated Animations 8.0.1 (a major update from 7.1.10) with dnd5e 6.0.6: seen twice in one smoke run of the kit (2026-10-27, first rehearsal), not seen in spells-deep alone. Not bisected against 7.1.10. Check when the modules are learned (Backlog: learn-modules) and remove the entry if a later 8.x release fixes it.

expected.match: using legacy syntax which should be migrated
expected.why: Foundry 14 deprecation warning for the old '-=key' forced deletion syntax. dnd5e-item-resources trips it on the kit heroes, and the warning lists autoanimations 8.0.1 and dnd5e 6.0.6 as packages using it (2026-10-27, first rehearsal). Upstream; the run lists it as known.

Casting Hold Person with the Strahd modules on logs 'ActiveEffect dnd5eparalyzed00 does not exist' (spells-deep). It is not the automated-conditions-5e update (the old 14.606.4.4 does it too); DAE or another module is the likely source (2026-10-27, first rehearsal). Unbisected.
A test kit artifact, not a bug: a chat card is deleted within 100 ms of its pop-up (TEST-KIT.md, 'The notification error'). The kit's GM page keeps it quiet; if it shows, the page hook broke.
DAE 14.x: a deprecated special duration on an old effect (walkthrough 2026-10-04). Upstream data, nothing for us to fix.
DAE logs a dnd5e deprecation warning in createRiderConditions on each applied effect (walkthrough 2026-10-04).
Actor Studio uses the deprecated V1 application framework; the warning shows on load. Our fork (I-116) does not change it.
A harmless 403 from the MrPrimate server when no Patreon key is set (walkthrough 2026-10-04).
Missing Tokenizer images from old-world data; a fresh kit world has none (walkthrough 2026-10-04). Unseen is normal.
